meta.name: bio-link-deployer
meta.description: Create a Linktree-style bio link hub page as a single self-contained HTML file. Triggers on: "create a bio link page", "make a linktree", "link in bio page", "bio link", "link hub", "create my link page", "all my links on one page", "linktree alternative", "build a link page", "bio page for my affiliate links", "I need a link in bio", "make a page with all my links", "link aggregator page".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把多个链接汇总成单页个人展示页
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把多个社交/推广链接集中到一个美观的页面展示
copy.tagline_en: Turn multiple links into one personal bio page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to showcase multiple links in a single attractive page

howto.what: 安装后，Claude可以根据你提供的名称、链接、头像和主题，自动生成一个单页HTML文件，作为你的个人简介链接聚合页。页面包含3种主题（简洁、暗色、渐变），手机友好，可直接保存为网页文件并部署。
howto.when: 当你说出“创建一个生物链接页面”“做一个Linktree”“把我的所有链接放在一页”等类似请求时，技能会被触发。

say.text: 把我今天做的所有内容做成一个生物链接页面。
say.note: 收集对话中已有的产品、博客、落地页链接，自动归类。

say.text: 我需要一个链接在个人简介的页面。
say.note: Claude会询问你的用户名和至少3个链接，然后生成页面。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a single self-contained HTML file for your bio link hub page, similar to Linktree. You provide name, links, avatar, and theme (minimal, dark, gradient). The page is mobile-first and ready to deploy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "create a bio link page", "make a linktree", "put all my links on one page", or similar requests.

say_en.text: Create a dark-themed bio link page for @sarahcontent with links like HeyGen, Semrush.
say_en.note: Generates a dark theme page with auto-categorized links.

say_en.text: Make a bio link page with everything we did today.
I need a link in bio page.
say_en.note: Claude asks for your username and at least three links, then creates the page.
